tweets: Rameswaram's Ramanathaswamy Temple holds the longest pillared corridor of any temple in India, over a thousand carved granite pillars in disciplined rows. Tradition holds Rāma worshipped Śiva here on his return from Laṅkā, epic and stone aligned.
